verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents native natural-language operation through Breeze Assistant: you describe a report in plain language and it builds it from your data, and you can plan a full campaign from a single goal. It also documents AI agents for marketing, sales and service, plus an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible AI agent read and write access to CRM contacts, deals and engagements. Missing for 10: documentation that the native assistant covers general product operation beyond reports and content or campaign generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language command reliability.
